summary: Notes that Windows modules are written in PowerShell, so their development guide differs from standard modules, and points to related resources.
questions: What language are Ansible Windows modules written in?
Where do I find docs for writing my own Windows module?

answer_card.title: Developing Windows modules
answer_card.answer_md: Windows modules are written in **PowerShell**, so their development process differs substantially from standard (Python) modules. See the `developing_modules_general_windows` guide.
